method.IPL: mov r16,[base+off] / mov r8,[base+off], dst in {ax,bx,cx,dx,si,di,bp | al,bl,cl,dl,ah,bh,ch,dh} (ah/bh/ch/dh high byte = byte granularity). IDA omits size prefix when register implies width (probe-verified) -> width criterion = register name. -> [ea,'IPL',E,off,'u16'|'u8']
method.IPS: mov [base+off],r16 / mov [base+off],r8, src partial register -> same event shape, kind 'IPS'
method.base_entity: base_ent: als->T:fn first, else def[reg]; prefixes T/M/P/G kept, S/RET/V suppressed (noise); off!=0 (ffl7/ffl8 semantics); HIWORD [base+X+2] covered by multi-constant offset folding in off_of
method.materialization: T:fn+off->M:fn:this:off | M:fn:this:A+off->M:fn:this:(A+off) | P:fn:k+off->PP:fn:k:off (k normalized to decimal per spec) | G:a+off->GP:a:off | off<0 dropped
method.type_candidates: granularity fixes width only, signedness unknown -> two candidates: u16->{short,unsigned short}, u8->{char,unsigned char}
method.ffl8_merge: entities overlapping anchors/insn_value_types.json (movzx/movsx = signedness proof) intersect candidate sets; empty intersection = width contradiction -> dropped
method.soundness: events fire pre-transfer (def state = before instruction); join = intersection, <=10 fixpoint rounds; bare mov only (movzx/movsx collected by ffl7/ffl8, overlap deduped here)
